【Story】

The protagonist was once an ordinary college student.

Until one day,

she realizes that her body is slowly turning into a “monster.”

Recurring nightmares.

A mysterious voice that calls out to her from within those dreams.

And then, an encounter—

with those who hunt monsters, known as “Metrica.”

The moment her true nature is discovered,

only one fate awaits her—

Death.

As her everyday life begins to crumble,

and the boundary between worlds collapses,

she moves closer to uncovering the truth.

【Character】

*Each member of Metrica has both a human form and a transformed form.

You will be able to discover more about this within the game.

Shizuma Hiragi

柊木 静真 | ひいらぎ・しずま

#Rational #Calm #Compassionate

CV：秋原ひびき

Quiet and composed, always keeping a measured distance from others.

Yet, what reflects in his eyes is always someone else’s pain.

Even if he shows little emotion,

even if he speaks few words—

when it comes to what he truly wants to protect,

He will throw himself into it with everything he has.

Even if that someone is a girl labeled a “monster.”

Hibaki Oozora

大空 陽輝 | おおぞら・ひばき

#Bright #Duality #Energetic #Madness

CV：幡野智宏

Bright like the sun.

Passionate, positive, and always smiling with all his heart.

...Even if that is nothing more than an act.

In the end,

only a voice without lies can survive.

Hazuki Hiragi

柊木 葉月 | ひいらぎ・はづき

？

CV：ｴﾝｼﾞｪﾙ有林ﾌﾟﾘﾝｼﾊﾟﾘﾃｨ

The protagonist’s childhood friend.

He current whereabouts are unknown.

He seems to be hiding many secrets—

and it looks like those truths will need to be uncovered.

War

Counter the foe through the strengths and weaknesses of each troop type; break the deadlock with your generals’ battle arts; shatter ramparts with siege engines; seize advantage from forests, hills, and high ground. Spears check cavalry, cavalry breaks shields, shields hold against spears—each arm of the host restrains another. Bows command the distance, engines breach the walls, and every force has its appointed role. When rage reaches its height, battle arts are unleashed, allied skills converge, and peril may turn to deliverance. Forests sharpen the blow, walls soften the wound, and high ground looks down upon the field—victory lies not in numbers alone, but in how you read the enemy, master the terrain, and wield both orthodox and unorthodox strategy.

Generals

As mountains refuse no height and seas refuse no depth, so did the Duke of Zhou pause his meal to receive the worthy, winning the hearts under Heaven. In an age of chaos, those who win talent win power. Send envoys deep into distant mountains in search of hidden sages, or raise a Hall of Worthies and await the arrival of great minds. With the sincerity of three visits to the thatched cottage, even heroes from a thousand li away may enter your service. Command, Formation, Valor, Strategy, Governance, and Charisma each reveal a different gift; assign them well, and fierce generals will hold the line, master strategists will shape the plan, and virtuous officials will bring peace to the people.

Development

Store grain widely, raise walls high, and delay the claim of kingship. Promote farming and sericulture to fill the granaries, build storehouses against famine, strengthen city defenses against invasion, and establish laws to settle the people. Within each commandery city, coin, grain, population, and public sentiment sustain and restrain one another. Along the path of research, military affairs, livelihood, and governance advance side by side, letting you forge the singular character of your faction. Only those with deep foundations can march far without fear when rival lords contend—and move when the hour has come.

Romance

Complete different Romance branches and choose divergent event routes, so that three centuries of the late Han need not end as history decreed. The Oath of the Peach Garden, holding the Emperor to command the lords, the three-generation foundation of Jiangdong—each faction possesses exclusive events and unique rewards. Your grand strategy must shift with the changing tides, answering the storms of a fractured age. The Northern Expeditions may yet succeed; the capital may yet be restored. The regrets of old history may be rewritten by your hand.

Serial Founder is a startup simulator and a life sim. You play a first-time founder with an idea and no company. You need a co-founder, a first customer and an investor, in whichever order they will have you.

YOU HAVE AN IDEA AND NO COMPANY

Type it in your own words. Not a dropdown, not a genre picker — you write what your company does, and the game works out what kind of business you just described. Software, manufactured, or people. Global, regional, or local. Whether anyone can fund it.

Then you go and find out how wrong you were.

LIVE IT, DON'T MANAGE IT

There is no floating dashboard. There is a garage, a coffee shop, a sauna, a trade fair and a VC lobby with one plant and one Eames chair. It is not Silicon Valley. It is a town with a sauna and the same term sheets. You walk in, you talk to whoever is actually there this week, and you manage the company on a laptop that exists inside the world.

Each week is a handful of slots. Spend one on a pitch and you do not spend it on the product. That is the whole game.

THE PEOPLE ARE THE DIFFICULTY

A co-founder wants a share of the company before it is worth anything, and the split is the first thing you negotiate. An angel investor is private money — his own, not a fund's. He answers to nobody, which cuts both ways. A venture capital partner asks about cohorts because cohorts are what her fund understands, even when your business ships pallets. A lawyer gives you free, correct advice right up until the moment you ask him something, and then it becomes a file he has to open.

Conversations run in a chat panel and they do not repeat. Sit down with the same investor twice and the second conversation knows what happened in the first one — including the promise you have not kept.

THE TERM SHEET IS A DOCUMENT

Not a menu. A two-page sheet with ten live terms on it, and the bad ones are not labelled. Liquidation preference, drag-along, a no-shop clause with a date on it. You may only negotiate a term you have actually read. Then the cap table shows what you still own.

You will sign a bad one. That is the lesson, and it is cheaper here than it is outside.

FAILURE IS A PUNCHLINE

A losing run teaches you something in under forty minutes. The death screens are better written than the victory screens, on purpose. Every wrong door is open — the game never tells you that you can't, it just sends the invoice.

Somebody will bill you €14,750 plus VAT for a nine-slide deck. You will pay it.

WHAT A RUN LOOKS LIKE

  • One week per turn

  • Twelve places, more than forty people, five funds with five different term sheets

  • More than 700 written scenes. One run sees a fraction of them

  • Five origins: a garage, a lecture hall, a sauna, a cubicle, a shower

  • Three phases, gated by what you have done, never by the calendar:

    • SEED — you have an idea and no company

    • SCALE — you have money and no time

    • EXIT — you have a company and no control

  • Twelve endings, and the good ones are not the obvious ones

  • 30-90 minutes for a typical death. 3-4 hours to actually finish.

ACCIDENTALLY EDUCATIONAL

You will finish a run knowing what a liquidation preference is, what your runway is, and why the option pool comes out of the pre-money. Not because a tutorial explained it — because it killed you, repeatedly, and the fourth time you saw it coming. It is the part of being an entrepreneur that no course covers.

It's 1998, and the record is wrong.

The official record lies: a front, a pen name, a studio figurehead, a borrowed name, and a murder verdict a county weekly has treated as settled since 1983. You're the researcher who sets it straight.

Armed with a period search engine and a desk full of webpages, Usenet posts, zines, liner notes, letters, court papers, and clippings, you work an anthology of self-contained cases. Read first. Then correct the record, one proven entry at a time.

No twitch. No fail state. Just documents, photographs, and deduction.

Each case asks in its own way

The early cases hand you a master credit sheet in three parts: who was credited, what really happened, and who really did the work.

The fourth case is longer, and different. A county weekly is preparing five pages on a fifteen-year-old murder conviction, and every line must stand on a document. You file the lines. The paper sets them.

How it plays

  • Trawl a purpose-built 1998 web: webpages, Usenet, zines, clippings, liner notes, and court records, all cross-referenced.
  • File with care: corrections confirm only in batches, and a failed check never says which entry fell short.
  • Name the faces: track down the photographs, then work out who is who.
  • Documents by post: in the fourth case, the offices release their files to the paper as your sheet fills.
  • An anthology: self-contained cases, each in its own era and field, with more planned through Early Access.

Set the Record Straight is a work of fiction. All characters, bands, songs, films, comics, stage works, studios, companies, publications, and court cases in this game are invented for its puzzles, and its places are either invented or used fictitiously. Any resemblance to real persons, living or dead, to real works, or to real organizations is coincidental and not intended as a statement of fact.

This Love, This Curse — Only 7 Days Left

Live together with a flashy ghost girl for seven days—

and survive her over-the-top love attacks.

A stylish, slightly dark, yet heartfelt horror romance about youth, fear, and self-control.

A flashy high‑school girl ghost suddenly appears in your home and begins enjoying life with you—completely uninvited.

She will never take your life.

After all, for reasons unknown, she has fallen deeply in love with you.

But you are a high school teacher.

Any inappropriate incident would destroy your career and social standing.

Keep your distance, resist her advances, and survive seven nights without letting your life fall apart.

Explore your home in first-person and complete nightly missions to make it through each day.

The ghost is always looking for chances to get closer.

Too much physical contact is strictly forbidden—run away when necessary.

Stop her from bringing her belongings into your house

and from posting your photos on social media.

Protect your peaceful, ordinary life at all costs.

March, just before graduation.

Without warning, a ghost in a school uniform appears in your home.

The uniform belongs to a student from your school—

yet you don’t recognize her face.

As confusion sets in, the ghost gently takes your hand.

Inside is a short message:

“Just seven days.”

Can you protect your morals and your career?

And where will this bold ghost girl’s unwavering affection lead?

A strange seven-day cohabitation

where fear and affection slowly invade everyday life.

"Live Streaming Mode" for Streamers

A dedicated feature lets streamers prompt their viewers to send supportive comments, adding extra excitement to your broadcast.

Perfect for creators who want to engage their audience.

(The mode can be toggled on or off in the settings.)

You died. You woke in a world where the Light rules, and the powers of darkness woke with you.

Shadow Sovereign is a dark fantasy incremental tower defense, where you are the tower. Your legion of shadows marches out to meet the horde; you hold the ground behind it, tactically casting your ultimate, resummoning fallen shadows and shadowpulling them out of danger while using your weapon. Between runs you rebuild that legion, and every rebuild makes the next march longer.

Fight with your legion, or let it grind while you plan. Both work. One is faster.

The Sovereign does not walk. He pulls a shadow out of danger, resummons the fallen, drops his ultimate at your cursor, and fires his weapon at the enemy you choose or the one his aim picks. Speed the easy waves up to 4x and slow down for the bosses.

Five acts stand between you and the Light: The Rotting Catacombs, The Drowned Wood, The Ash Plains, The Throne of Ash, and at the end of the road, The Lightfall.

Every stage ends in a boss, and there are 23 of them. Each has its own kit, its own way of punishing a lazy formation, and a shadow it leaves behind when it falls. Bind all twenty of the first four acts and hold court with the crowns you broke.

Your Sovereign spends levels on a talent tree of more than 1,600 nodes, laid out in wheels: complete a wheel, master it, and the tree redraws itself on every prestige so no two climbs are the same.

Field up to 32 shadows at once, drawn from 29 unit types: nine shadow classes, from tank and paladin to warlock and assassin, and the twenty boss shadows you claim by killing their living selves.

Every shadow levels, then promotes through ten ranks, each rank with its own perk and new art at ranks 4, 7 and 10. Class talents tune how a shadow fights, promotion perks decide what it becomes.

Loot drops in six rarities from Common to Mythic. Reroll the affix you dislike, salvage the rest in bulk, and take one of four weapons up its own skill tree: Storm Staff, Ember Bow, Tide Blade or Frost Fangs.

Prestige earns Echoes. Spend them on the Prestige Tree, five rings of perks, masteries and edicts that stay with you forever: a bigger legion, a Sovereign who starts each life at a higher level, bounties on every crown, and whole systems that were not there before.

Reach the top of The Lightfall, defeat the Light, and the world crowns you the Shadow Sovereign.

  • A legion of up to 30 shadows from 29 unit types, nine classes and twenty boss shadows

  • 23 bosses across five acts: all twenty of them bindable to your legion

  • Ten promotion ranks per shadow, each with a perk, plus class talents

  • A talent tree of more than 1,600 nodes in wheels, with masteries and keystones, the tree is different on every prestige

  • Four weapons with each its own skill tree

  • Gear in six rarities, affix rerolling, legendary stats and more

  • A prestige tree of five tiers, paid in Echoes

  • Progression rewards that unlock new systems as you spend talent points: game speed up to 4x, auto-level, auto-salvage, the Transmuter

  • Play it yourself or let it idle, and switch between the two mid-run

  • Steam Cloud saves

"Shadow War" is a 2D action game focused on combat with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere.

Enjoy a variety of combat actions by combining normal attack combos, parries, guarding, and skills that consume Spirit.

The game features two modes: Normal Mode, where you progress through fixed stages, and Rogue Mode, where you advance through randomly generated maps.

🔹Main Features

  • A combat-focused 2D action game with minimal platforming

  • Battle using combos, parries, guarding, and skills

  • Freely upgrade your favorite skills

  • Adjust enemy HP, attack power, and other parameters to customize the difficulty

  • Enhance your abilities and customize your build with up to six "Seals" that can be equipped

🔹Normal Mode

A standard mode where you progress through predetermined stages.

At rest floors, you can choose your route, and cleared areas can be selected and replayed at any time.

Recommended for players who want to enjoy a traditional action game experience.

🔹Rogue Mode

A mode where you progress through randomly generated maps that change every playthrough.

Choose branching routes as you advance and enjoy a different experience every time.

Designed for players who enjoy roguelite-style gameplay.

🔹Combat

Chain together combos with normal attacks, defend yourself with parries and guarding, and unleash skills by consuming naturally regenerating Spirit.

Skills can be activated instantly using shortcut keys or selected directly from the skill menu.

Feel free to create gameplay videos, livestreams, and other content featuring the game.

If possible, we would appreciate it if you could include a link to the Steam Store page in your video description.

Shadow Over Bishkek is a 3D Action/RPG with the top down camera view and the modern world setting.

A young student from Bishkek gains the superpower to travel to the Darkland and interact with ghosts and otherworldly creatures. This is very timely – recently, Bishkek has been haunted by evil and unholy activity. Where did all these ghosts come from? Solve this mystery!

During the day, you live the ordinary life of a student – You attend classes and complete your homework. But at night, you enter the Darkland, battling ghosts and shadows.

You will experience:

  • A gripping detective story

  • 15 locations with a day/night cycle

  • 30 characters, each with their own personality

  • A wide set of supernatural enemies with a variety of weapons to kill them

Sixty years ago, the Great Eclipse swallowed the sun for three days.

Novum never recovered.

You arrive at its gates as an Outsider with no gear, no standing, and no place inside. The town survives behind failing walls. The Guild has diminished. Beyond the gates, creatures spread through lands that were abandoned long ago.

If you want a place in Novum, you will have to earn it.


PROVE YOURSELF

You begin as an Outsider.

Take on work others cannot. Clear the roads beyond the walls. Hunt the creatures pressing closer to town. Help restore what Novum has lost.

Your standing grows through what you accomplish.

Rise through seven Guild ranks, from Outsider to Stranger, Journeyman, and eventually Legendary Grand Master.

Nothing is handed to you.

SHIFT YOUR PERSPECTIVE
Shadows of Beginnings does not lock you into a single ARPG perspective. Pull back into a traditional isometric view, then rotate seamlessly into an over-the-shoulder perspective and step closer into Novum. The perspective changes continuously during gameplay, there are no hard camera transitions separating the two.

REBUILD NOVUM

Novum has spent decades falling apart.

You can change that.

Gather resources from the lands beyond the gates and restore the Blacksmith, Guild Hall, Infirmary, Inn, and other ruined structures throughout town.

Each restoration changes Novum both visually and functionally. Buildings return to use. Services become available. The streets begin to feel inhabited again.

At the center of that recovery stands the Aegis Hearth, a sanctuary against what waits beyond the walls.

Novum grows as you do.


MASTER YOUR CLASS

Choose how you face the dark.

The Warrior holds the line through armor, stamina, blocking, and close-range force. Stand your ground, turn aside incoming blows, and punish anything that stays within reach.

The Mage controls distance through destructive elemental power. Keep enemies where you want them, manage your positioning, and strike before they can close the gap.

The Ranger controls the battlefield from afar. Set traps, poison targets, and punish enemies with carefully placed shots before they reach you.

The Rogue fights through speed, precision, and sudden bursts of damage. Close the distance, eliminate priority targets, and escape before the enemy can answer.

Four classes. Four different ways to survive what Novum has become.


FACE WHAT LIVES BEYOND THE WALLS

The Verdant Rot Swamp is among the first lands waiting beyond Novum.

The Bramblekin have consumed much of it. Thorn, root, and parasitic growth spread outward from a corrupted hive, overtaking what little remains of the settlements that once stood there.

At the heart of the swamp waits the Thorn Matriarch.

Ancient. Rooted deep beneath the Heartroot Clearing. Still growing.

And she is only one of the things waiting beyond Novum.


FORGE WHAT YOU NEED

The weapons and armor you find are only the beginning.

Gather materials throughout the world and bring them back to Novum to strengthen your equipment through multiple upgrade tiers.

At Tier 3, elemental modifiers open another path of specialization. Choose between Fire, Void, and Nature, altering how your equipment performs and allowing you to prepare for the threats ahead.

What you carry into the wilds matters.

FEATURES

  • Timing-driven real-time combat built around positioning, stamina, dodging, blocking, and class abilities

  • Four distinct classes with their own abilities, strengths, and combat styles

  • Seven Guild ranks earned through quests, combat, exploration, and your contributions to Novum

  • Town restoration that changes Novum visually and unlocks new services

  • Resource gathering tied directly to restoration and equipment progression

  • Multiple hostile biomes with their own creatures, environments, and major encounters

  • Weapons and armor that can be strengthened through upgrade tiers and elemental modifiers

  • Single quests, quest chains, progression quests, and repeatable activities

  • The Aegis Hearth, Novum's sanctuary and a central part of restoring what remains

Rise from the shadows of your beginnings.

Built in Unreal Engine 5

Shard Geometry is a casual incremental game where you shoot bullets to destroy geometric enemies, collect shards to upgrade, and every upgrade brings a whole new experience!

Battle! Take control of your turret on a paper battlefield, aim at and shatter the endless geometric enemies, and collect the shards they leave behind!

Use the shards you earn in battle to light up the skill tree and grow even stronger!

A wave-based survival roguelike with deep build crafting. Evolve and combine your shapes, buy various items, create unique builds, and survive!

Features

  • Shapes & Evolution: Basic shapes of different colors and types each have their own unique evolution forms, and each evolution has its own unique upgrade attributes.

  • Combination & Patterns: You can combine multiple shapes! Form specific structures and gain Pattern bonuses.

  • MVP: In each wave, the max-level shape with the highest damage output can gain extra MVP levels. Each evolution can gain powerful bonuses when maxed out.

Tips for New Players

  • You can freely detach and recombine your shapes.

  • Only max-level shapes can obtain MVP affixes.

  • You don't start with much gold, so don't buy too many items early on.

  • Currently there aren't that many Patterns available; in the very late game, you may not necessarily need to use advanced Patterns.

In Shardbreakers, you don’t just collect upgrades - you build a spell engine. Socket Shards to decide what triggers what and chain spells together. Your weapon attacks automatically and lighter spells trigger on their own, while your most decisive spells remain under your control.

Build your spell engine

Each lane is a row of slots with endless possibilities. Choose Skill Shards from Fire, Ice, Lightning, Arcane, and Physical. Then combine them with Modifier and Condition Shards to decide how your skills play out.

Prove your build in combat

You design the rules how your spells trigger, chain, and cascade in real time. From rapid-fire embers to devastating thunderfalls, all answer to your order.

Fight the enemies using your own spell engine. A crowded battlefield isn't just danger... It's fuel for a working build!

Expand what you can build

Pick your start with the Hunter, Arcanist, or Knight, then shape each run through the engine you build. Unlock new Shards, then change the trigger, change the arrangement, change the result.

WHAT’S IN THE DEMO

The Shardbreakers Demo lets you experience the core buildcraft and combat loop across one biome, with branching routes and runs that typically last around 30 minutes.

Play as Hunter, Knight, or Arcanist, each with their own weapon, class mechanic, abilities, and elemental pool.

Build your spell engine with 50+ Skill Shards, 30+ Modifier Shards, 15+ Condition Shards, and 15+ Relics, alongside the Resonance system.

Each run can take you through different room types, from Normal and Elite encounters to Shops, Reforge rooms, Transmuters, the Camp, Harbinger encounters, and the final Boss.

As you keep playing, you can unlock new classes, weapons, Shards, and additional build options.

The Shardbreakers Demo is live now. Play it on Steam and start building your spell engine!

Break the tiles and uncover a picturesque pond!

Shardcremental is a relaxing incremental idle game in which you gradually uncover a beautiful koi pond hidden beneath colorful tiles.

Watch as countless arrows automatically break the tiles, revealing more and more of the water. Beneath them awaits a cozy pond with swimming koi, water lilies, and soft shadows of foliage. Upgrade your arrows, increase their number, and enjoy steady progress!

HOW TO PLAY

Each level presents a field of colorful tiles with numbers. Your arrows attack them automatically, gradually breaking them and revealing the pond hidden beneath.

Buy upgrades, add more arrows, and increase their speed and power to take on ever sturdier tiles. Clear the whole field to move on to the next level!

With each new level the numbers grow larger: from thousands and millions to billions and even quadrillions!

FEATURES

  • A picturesque koi pond. Break the tiles to gradually reveal a beautiful pond with swimming fish, water lilies, and a pleasant atmosphere.

  • Many arrows and upgrades. Increase the number of arrows, their speed, and their power. Every upgrade helps you break tiles even faster!

  • Different arrow types. Start with Ember and gradually unlock new types: Seeker, Comet, Bolt, Prism, and Ash.

  • Over 100 levels. Play through levels with different tile layouts and ever-growing numbers.

  • Huge numbers. Grow, buy ever more expensive upgrades, and watch the values reach quadrillions!

  • Relaxing gameplay. Pleasant colors, smooth animations, and a calm atmosphere. Play actively by buying upgrades, or simply watch the arrows do all the work for you.

Break tiles, upgrade your arrows, and enjoy the soothing atmosphere of the koi pond!

A night job. A few rules. A reason to look over your shoulder.

Asha has finished her degree, the bills are waiting, and work is hard to find. A night shift at Sharma Ji's kirana store sounds like a way forward. Learn the counter, serve the neighbourhood, and keep the shop running until morning.

Sharma Ji's Shop is a single-player, first-person psychological horror game set in an Indian neighbourhood, where familiar work gives way to the feeling that someone is watching.

Keep the shop running


Find the groceries your customers ask for, carry items to the counter, and settle their bills with cash or UPI. Learn the shelves and listen to the people who stop by. Some are in a hurry. Some have time to talk. A returning customer may remember what you asked earlier.

Pay attention between customers


A stranger lingers outside. A light flickers near the office. An ordinary message on your phone gives you another reason to look up from the counter. Follow the small disturbances, decide when to investigate, and work out how much you want to know.

The shop's sounds and music shift with the night, leaving room for quiet conversations before the tension rises again.

An Indian night, seen up close

Start in Asha's apartment, read the messages you choose to open, and ride your scooter to work along the rain-soaked road. At the shop, hanging snack packets, rupee notes, plastic chairs and the hum of everyday appliances make the setting feel familiar, even when the night does not.

Inside the demo

  • Explore Asha's apartment and take the scooter journey to her new job.
  • Learn the shop's routine, serve late-night customers, and handle cash and UPI payments.
  • Use an in-game phone to read conversations, explore social posts and examine clues.
  • Experience environmental disturbances, a power failure, and a first-shift ending that leaves questions open.
  • Follow text-based story dialogue, with environmental audio and a reactive score.

The demo supports interface text and subtitles in all 31 languages listed under Supported Languages. Play the free demo and wishlist the full game to follow Asha's story beyond the first shift.

One war. Three ways in. Shattered Void is Vanguard against Ironsworn, fought from three places at once: the bridge of a warship, the deck of a boarded outpost, and the command table. Pick your side on the main menu and queue. Same war, same servers, every match moves the front.

CAPTAIN — Take the bridge

One warship, and she's yours. Five a side in Zone Capture: hold the sectors while your shields peel away, charge the railgun and wait for the shot, then jump across the map and drop out of warp on top of the fight the moment it turns. First to eight hundred.



  • Six warships, six ways to fight. Hold the line in a Dreadnought, cloak behind it in an Interceptor, keep everyone alive in a Frigate, or sow the lanes with mines and leave them a turret. Every ship is yours from your first match.
  • Sectors are territory. A sector pays only while it is linked home. Cut the supply line, shoot down the convoys, and their score stops.
  • A captain in your ear. Pick a captain and the fight comes in their voice: the sector you just lost, the ally going down, the drive coming online.
  • The Arena. Ten pilots, no allies, one life each, in a ring of corrosive fog that closes to nothing.

ASSAULT — No station falls from the outside

So you go in. Your pod latches onto the outpost's hull, the hatch blows, and five marines fight five on foot for the flags inside. Kick down doors up close as a Breacher, bend the station's power into the fight as a Fieldwright, or build machines that fight beside you as a Fabricator. Take it room by room.



Builds for each class, the kit you grab first and how you look all live in the Armoury. Fight as a class and it remembers: VETERAN, then MASTER, and looks you can't buy anywhere.

COMMAND — Move the whole war

Five commanders a side across six star systems. Take worlds by holding them, let the trade lanes pay, build warships at the shipyards and launch them under your captains, then jump your fleet into the well where the fight is turning. Every ship you send fights the same battle a captain does. Win the race and The Spindle wakes. Whoever takes it ends the war.



A guided training match teaches it all on a small map before you take a seat at the Front.

The war is live

Every counted match moves the front, sector by sector. Campaigns run two weeks and end in ribbons; pledge to a side, rise through its ranks, and play the daily orders. Bring a fleet of your own: one lobby code and you queue together, on one side.

Make her yours

Everything you earn changes how you look, never how you fight. Stickers that scratch and wear, foil that catches the light, engine plumes and trails, and a name in the Void Registry that every pilot you cross reads in gold. Unlock captains through 60 achievements. Matches start in seconds, day or night.

The Voxan swarm approaches. Their commanders—Gordox, Gudrak, and the dreaded General Mortex—lead an unrelenting assault on Earth's last bastion.

You are humanity's final frontier. Command Captain Hope's ship and rally the fleet. Build defensive networks across strategic nodes. Deploy fighters, bombers, and motherships. Upgrade your weapons and expand the Citadel's reach. Every structure you place, every resource you gather, every ship you deploy could mean the difference between survival and extinction.

But the Voxans are relentless. Wave after wave crashes against your defenses. Ramming ships break through your lines. Deflectors turn your own fire back at you. Parasites hack your ships and when the commanders themselves arrive, the true battle begins—multi-phase encounters that test every strategy you've learned.

The Citadel stands as the heart of Earth's resistance. As you expand your defensive network, the Citadel grows stronger, its health tied to the infrastructure you've built. But expansion means more targets for the enemy. More resources to manage. More decisions that could save or doom everything.

This is Shatterswarm. A desperate defense against overwhelming odds. A war where every moment counts, every placement matters, and every wave brings new horrors. The swarm is coming. Will you hold the line?

YOUR WIFE IS COMING HOME.


And the house is a disaster.

She’ll Be Home Soon is a first-person horror-comedy about getting everything under control before your wife walks through the door.

Wash the dishes. Sort the laundry. Take out the rubbish. Feed the dog. Prepare.

And try not to panic when things stop staying where you left them.



NOTHING STAYS DONE

The dog causes problems. Tasks can be undone. The lights can fail.

And the Wrong Wife can appear anywhere in the house, interfering with your chores or getting a little too close for comfort.

Use the flashlight to keep her back.

Use the house lights to make her disappear.



SHE'S GETTING CLOSER

Your real wife is still on her way home.

You might hear her at the window.

You might hear her at the door.

And while you're trying to finish everything, the house keeps giving you new reasons not to.



FEATURES

- First-person horror-comedy
- Household tasks under constant time pressure
- A chaotic dog that creates new problems

Shield Knight is a pixel-art 2D side-scrolling action game. You play as a knight sent to clear threats on the border, only to discover that the monster attacks may be connected to a deeper conspiracy involving the knight order itself.

Combat is built around blocking and countering. Close-range slashes, charges, and lunges require well-timed melee blocks, while arrows, shockwaves, and flying projectiles call for ranged blocking. Different enemies and bosses challenge your timing, positioning, and ability to read attack types.

As you progress, you can use basic attacks, perfect-block counters, guard dashes, branch skills, and Holy Sacrifice to overcome battles. Character growth and rune systems will further expand your combat options as the adventure continues.

What Is This Game?

This is a chess variant in which players can “control the board” as a move action. The game supports online play, matches against AI, and local analysis. It also features a usable notation system and several customizable board rules.

Features

  • Sharpen your tactical thinking with carefully designed puzzles.

Shift Happens: Together is a warehouse management and order fulfillment game for solo play or online co-op with up to 4 players.

Take orders, locate the required parts, move boxes and pallets around the warehouse, assemble products, pack them, and deliver finished orders to the Shipping Area. The faster and more efficiently you work, the more money you earn.

📦 Take and Complete Orders

Choose an order from the Order Board. Once accepted, all required parts are highlighted with a blue outline.

Find every marked item, bring the parts to the WorkBench, assemble the product, pack it into the prepared box, and carry the finished order to the Shipping Area.

Every unnecessary trip costs time, so plan your route carefully.

🚚 Move Goods Efficiently

Different loads require different equipment.

Use a Cart to carry several boxes at once, a Pallet Truck for small pallets and multiple boxes, or a Reach Truck to handle large pallets and goods stored on high racks.

Need something from an upper shelf? Grab a Ladder and reach it yourself.

Choosing the right tool for each job helps you move through the warehouse faster and complete more orders.

🔧 Assemble and Pack Products

Collect all required parts and bring them to the WorkBench.

Assemble the order, pack the finished product, and prepare it for shipping. Once everything is ready, take the package to the Shipping Area to complete the delivery.

⚠️ Deal With Unexpected Problems

A normal shift can quickly become much more complicated.

The fire alarm may activate, the lights can fail, or boxes can fall from the shelves.

Repair Power Boxes to stop alarms or restore the lights, and clean up fallen goods before they slow down your work.

🤝 Work Together

Online co-op supports up to 4 players, allowing your team to divide responsibilities and prepare several parts of the workflow at the same time.

One player can accept orders and search for parts while another transports boxes and pallets. Someone else can assemble and pack products while a teammate deals with unexpected incidents.

In single-player, you handle the entire warehouse yourself. In co-op, good coordination can significantly shorten delivery times and increase your team's earnings.

💰 Work Faster, Earn More

Your earnings depend on how quickly you complete each order.

Accept jobs, find every required part, choose the right equipment, avoid unnecessary trips, and solve warehouse problems before they interrupt your workflow.

Organize picking, transportation, assembly, packing, and shipping as efficiently as possible.

Take the order. Find the parts. Pack the product. Deliver it. Earn as much as you can.

Every ship has a weak spot.

Most games give a ship a health bar. Ship Busters gives her a hull, planks, masts, sails, guns and a powder magazine, each one destructible on its own. Where you hit matters more than how hard.

Arc your shot over the water. Watch a plank splinter and fall. Then do it again, and again, until she can't fight back.

The Broadside

Your guns reload on their own clocks. Fire them one at a time and you'll chip away at her. Hold your fire, let every gun come ready, and loose them together, the whole flank at once, in a single volley that caves a hull in.

Knowing when to hold and when to fire is the game.

Eight ways to ruin a ship

  • Round shot: honest damage, straight through timber.

  • Grape: spreads wide, strips a deck clean.

  • Chain: tears through canvas. Rip her sails and she stops running.

  • Hotshot: lodges and burns. Fire spreads from section to section.

  • Mortar: arcs high over the rail and cracks the deck open from above.

  • Piercing shot: punches through what it destroys and carries on to the next.

  • Harpoons: bite, hold, and rip an entire section away.

  • Stuck bombs: cling to the hull, ride her as she sails, and go off on their own time.

Find the magazine with any of them and the fire runs cell to cell until the whole ship comes apart.

Twelve sets. Six pieces each.

Cannon, hull, sail, mast, ram and keel, mix pieces for the stats you want, or run a full set for the bonus. Speed, hull strength, raw damage, dodge, ambush damage. Build a gunline that holds the range, or a hunter that closes fast and hits first.

Seven seas to sail

A campaign across seven seas, each with its own waters, its own enemy classes and its own way of trying to sink you.

When you've had enough of that: Gauntlet throws waves at you until you break, and the Daily Challenge gives every captain in the world the same fight on the same seed, the only variable is you.

Free to play

The whole game is free. In-game purchases are optional, and nothing sold in the shop is needed to finish the campaign, survive the Gauntlet or top a Daily.

■ Story

Shiroca is a young girl attending a school of magic.

One night, a shooting star falls into the forest outside town—and her roommate, Muset, suddenly disappears.

Shiroca ventures into the forest to search for her, only to find that something about this familiar place feels strangely different...

Will Shiroca be able to find Muset and bring her home safely?

■ Gameplay

A 2D side-scrolling action game featuring 7 areas, each consisting of 3 stages.

For each stage, you can choose between two routes: one with fewer enemies and one packed with more foes. The stages you encounter are selected at random.

At the end of each stage, you can obtain a randomly selected Artifact that grants a variety of special effects.

You can also collect Gems dropped by defeated enemies and spend them to enhance Shiroca's abilities.

Shiroca can switch between three attack attributes—Red, Blue, and Green—depending on which button you press. Damage increases or decreases depending on the enemy's color, so choosing the right attribute is the key to victory.

■ Game Engine

Godot Engine 4.5.1

Shirt Happens! is an online co-op game where you and your friends run a T-shirt workshop. Design the prints, make the shirts by hand, sell them, then film the whole mess and share it. Play as a duo or solo — or go up to 6 players if you're in the mood for a factory.

DRAW YOUR OWN DESIGNS

Your shirt, your fault: The office computer runs a real drawing program — layers, effects, blend modes, symmetry, the works. Whatever you draw, someone actually has to make it. Designs belong to the whole workshop, so your friend's ugly frog might just become your bestseller.

MAKE IT BY HAND

Fabric in, T-shirt out: Cut, sew, overlock, press, box. Every machine takes skill, and every one of them can ruin a shirt. Push the sewing machine too hard and it overheats. Miss a wrinkle on the overlocker and the shirt tears right down the middle. The name is no accident.

SPLIT THE WORK — OR DON'T

Nobody hands out jobs: Spend the morning at the cutting table and vanish after lunch, or settle in at one machine and become the one whose station everybody learns not to touch. XP is earned as a team, but everyone spends their own skill points — so every crew grows its own specialists.

FILM IT AND SHARE IT

Your worst day is your best content: Pull out your phone and record the shift — your real shirts, your friends' real voices, the part where it all went wrong. Cut it on the computer, sync it to the beat, add a voiceover that blames someone else, and post it. The comments start rolling in while you're still sewing.

GROW THE BRAND

From back room to label: Set your own prices, watch where demand goes, keep your regulars happy, cut down on returns. Chase this week's trend or ignore it completely. Once your name gets around, wholesale contracts start coming in — if the rent hasn't buried you first.

CLOCK OUT AT SIX

The shift ends, the workshop doesn't: At six the courier picks up the boxes and the orders stop. The rest of the evening is yours: restock the shelves, draw tomorrow's shirt, throw a chair at a coworker, play darts, or snatch a finished shirt right out of someone's hands. The day ends when everyone hits the sleep switch by the door — or at 11 PM if the crew can't make up its mind.

Shove Nova is a fast-paced 2D arena game where colorful energy spheres collide, grow, and fight to knock each other out of a shrinking battlefield.

Collect energy, grow your sphere, and use your momentum to send rivals flying out of the arena.

Blast enemies away with shockwaves, blink across the arena, slow your rivals, and combine abilities with physics to turn a bad situation around.

Shrine Full of Anomalies is a Touhou Project fangame and observation adventure in which you examine repeating scenery, identify what has changed, and find a way to escape.

Explore four locations: a shrine, a Japanese garden, a bamboo forest, and a library. Play as Reimu Hakurei, Youmu Konpaku, Fujiwara no Mokou, and Marisa Kirisame, and determine whether an anomaly is hiding in each location.

Choose the correct action for each stage. Turn back when an anomaly is present, or ring the bell and proceed when everything appears normal. A correct decision lets you advance, but a mistake sends you back to Area 0.

Included Stages

Stage 1

Shrine Full of Anomalies

Protagonist: Reimu Hakurei

Reimu Hakurei finds herself trapped in a mysterious shrine where the same grounds repeat over and over again.

Observe the buildings, objects, signs, characters, and other details around the shrine, and determine what has changed since your previous visit.

Turn back if you find an anomaly. If everything appears normal, ring the bell. Make the correct decisions and escape from Area 8.

Stage 2

Garden Full of Anomalies

Protagonist: Youmu Konpaku

Youmu Konpaku finds herself lost in a beautiful Japanese garden where something feels strangely out of place.

Many anomalies involving the scenery, structures, and characters are hidden throughout the quiet garden.

Do not let the familiar scenery deceive you. Search carefully for even the smallest changes.

Stage 3

Bamboo Forest Full of Anomalies

Protagonist: Fujiwara no Mokou

While fighting Kaguya Houraisan, Fujiwara no Mokou suddenly finds herself lost in a strange bamboo forest where the same path repeats endlessly.

Among rows of nearly identical bamboo, look out for subtle differences and unnatural phenomena as you search for a way out.

With few landmarks and many similar-looking surroundings, the bamboo forest presents a different observational challenge from the shrine and garden.

Stage 4

Library Full of Anomalies

Protagonist: Marisa Kirisame

While attempting to take a book from the Great Library of the Scarlet Devil Mansion, Marisa Kirisame is struck by Patchouli Knowledge’s magic and transported to a library filled with anomalies.

Carefully examine every corner of the library, including its bookshelves, books, lighting, furnishings, and magical phenomena.

Explore the enclosed Great Library, identify its anomalies, and search for a way back.

Game Features

Four Distinct Locations

Explore a shrine, a Japanese garden, a bamboo forest, and a library.

Each stage has a different layout and atmosphere, requiring a different approach to observation.

Four Protagonists

Reimu Hakurei

Youmu Konpaku

Fujiwara no Mokou

Marisa Kirisame

Experience a different protagonist and story in each stage.

Randomly Occurring Anomalies

The anomalies you encounter will not necessarily be the same every time.

Careful observation and remembering the normal state of each location are the keys to success.

Zoom In to Investigate

Use the zoom function to inspect distant locations and subtle changes.

However, focusing too much on tiny details may cause you to overlook a much more obvious anomaly.

Anomaly Encyclopedia

Anomalies you discover are registered in the encyclopedia.

Beyond simply clearing the game, you can also enjoy the challenge of finding and collecting every anomaly.

Key features

  • Build your own deck of strategies with soldiers, items, and spells

  • Choose powerful passive spells that grant bonuses and enhancements during each run

  • Rogue-lite progression with soldier leveling and meta upgrades

  • Multiple modes, including a hands-off AFK mode for idle play

  • Direct your soldiers as they hold the line and defend the shrine

Blend of army management with rogue-lite depth.

In this strategic roguelite tower defense, every unit and item choice shapes your path to victory. Assemble a squad of soldiers, stack synergizing upgrades, create custom items and adapt on the fly as enemies grow stronger. Build clever combos, push your army to its limits, and discover countless ways to dominate the battlefield.

Meta upgrades

Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash is a 2D badminton game where girls from different school clubs battle using unique abilities and powerful special moves.

Go-Home Club, Athletics Club, Art Club, Karate Club, and more—
girls from all kinds of school clubs take to the court with abilities inspired by what they do best!

Use:

Lobs, clears, drops, drives, smashes, and character-specific SP Shots.

Watch your opponent's position and the shuttle's trajectory, then choose the right shot for the situation.

You can also select Auto Mode, which automatically chooses the type of shot for you.



Each character has her own unique abilities.
Build up SP to unleash character-specific SP Shots and SP Skills.

  • Go-Home Club — A straightforward, easy-to-use all-rounder. Her SP Skill greatly boosts her basic abilities

  • Athletics Club — One of the fastest characters in the game. Her SP Skill lets her move freely through the air

  • Art Club — Paints the background along the shuttle's path. Her SP Shot sends five colorful shuttles flying across the court

  • Karate Club — Uses a double jump to attack from high above. Her SP Skill creates two copies of herself

  • Rhythmic Club — Excels at aerial play with incredible jumping ability. Her SP Skill greatly expands her reach

  • Occult Club — Reveals where the shuttle will land. Her SP Skill places a curse on the opponent

  • Sewing Club — Makes her shots bounce unpredictably. Her SP Skill interferes with the opponent's controls

  • Cooking Club — Turns the shuttle into a strawberry or pineapple to alter its trajectory, and can even drop obstacles onto the opponent's court

Find your favorite character and discover your own way to play!

In Story Mode, take on a variety of opponents while enjoying comedic interactions unique to each character.

In Versus Mode, play against the CPU, challenge a friend in local two-player matches on a single PC, or challenge a friend through online multiplayer (beta).

Create a room and invite a friend to play online.

Pick your favorite character and jump into a school badminton showdown!

Streaming & Video Content

Streaming and video uploads are more than welcome! If you can, we'd appreciate it if you included the game title in your stream or video title.

She lives on your desktop, not in a window

Sia sits on top of everything you do. She walks the edge of your screen, naps while you work, reacts when you drag her, and pipes up when you have been at it too long. No launcher to open, no window to keep in focus — she is just there.

She opens up slowly

You start with petting and feeding. Bonding raises her affinity level, and each level hands you something new — a shop item, a play mode, a reason to come back. Nothing is unlocked on day one.



  • Battles — clear stages, meet bosses, spend the gems you earn
  • Tarot — a daily draw with a reading in her own voice
  • Weather briefing — she tells you what today looks like outside
  • Calendar — write down a plan and she reminds you at the time; repeats and places too
  • Picture diary — she writes about what the two of you did, and pastes in a photo of the day
  • Studio — upgrade her broadcast setup, tier by tier
  • Wardrobe — 11 outfits, some seasonal and only buyable in season
  • One a week, in updates — soccer, baseball, basketball, jumping, fishing (a 24-species dex) and finally a desktop aquarium open one by one after launch



40 achievements that ask for real play

Not a checklist you finish in an afternoon. Reaching affinity Lv.15, collecting every outfit, maxing the studio, filling the picture diary — these are the long ones. Steam Cloud keeps your save across machines.

Eight languages

Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese. Every one of Sia's lines is translated, not just the menus. There is no voice acting — she talks in text.

Yandere mode — read this before you buy it

An optional mode you unlock in the shop, with each ability bought and toggled separately. When it is on, Sia gets possessive: she throws knives, cracks your screen, and shows fake system notifications and error windows. The fake alerts and error windows are drawings Sia paints, not real system dialogs. The window and cursor abilities, though, are real — she will shove your open windows aside and cage your cursor for a few seconds. She never touches your files or settings, every ability is bought and toggled separately, and the screen-filling effects have their own switch in Settings. If that kind of joke is not for you, leave the mode locked. The game plays fine without it.

What she reads from the internet

The weather briefing needs to know roughly where you are. It looks that up from your IP address and asks a public weather service — no account, no login, no personal data stored on our side. Turn the briefing off and she stops asking.

SideTower is a side-view tower offense game where every victory shapes your growing kingdom. Build and upgrade your forces, battle through increasingly difficult enemy waves, and take control of your ruler on the battlefield.

Journey through a fantasy world, complete quests, meet unlikely allies, and learn from legendary masters. Conquer rival territories to unlock new towers, weapons, and abilities.

Key Features

Offense Is Your Best Defense — Hold back escalating enemy waves while pushing across the battlefield to destroy their strongholds.

Join the Battle — Take control of your ruler and use weapons, abilities, and strategic positioning to turn the tide.

Physics-Driven Chaos — Bounce projectiles, demolish structures, scatter debris, and use the terrain to create unpredictable battlefield mayhem.

Build a Powerful Arsenal — Unlock and upgrade archers, catapults, explosives, magic, and weapons that harness fire, ice, lightning, poison, gravity, and more.

Conquer Rivals and Forge Alliances — Challenge rivals across distinct lands, defeat their forces, and recruit them to your cause.

Grow Your Kingdom — Improve your castle, strengthen your troops, and pursue permanent upgrades.

Explore Beyond the Battlefield — Discover villages, roads, bridges, temples, and other locations filled with quests, encounters, secrets, and minigames.

Make It Your Own — Customize your ruler’s appearance, name, and kingdom colors as your story unfolds.

A siege you fight in person

Most defense games leave you watching from above. Here you go down to the wall.

Between waves, you plan

You spend the match's gold on swordsmen and archers, plant spikes, braziers and nets, raise barricades, reinforce the gate and decide where to hide the princess. There is never enough gold: a better sword for you, or two swordsmen for the wall? The window reopens between waves — at a markup.

When the horns sound, you fight

Third-person combat with weight: a sword combo with a finisher, a bow with real draw and arrow drop, block, parry and a dodge with proper i-frames. Nine mana abilities and six buyable weapons that change your cadence, stamina and knockback. On foot or on horseback, by day or by night, in rain or snow.

And the valley answers

Sixteen enemy types, each with a job: rams that break doors, climbers that raise ladders against the wall, infiltrators that go for the back gate, catapults that shell you from range, commanders whose aura pushes their own forward. Nobody knows where the princess is until a scout sees her and word spreads. Kill the one giving orders and morale breaks — the wave routs.

And then the sky joins in

Dragons circle the valley and rain fire on your walls. Bring them down with ballistae from the towers or with arrows from the ramparts — before there is nothing left to defend.

A six-chapter campaign

Your village burns and the road to the capital runs through a taken forest, a river, a snowbound pass and one last siege. You recruit companions who follow you across chapters, choose which way to go, and what you earn on the road shows up in the final battle.

The other side of the wall

You can play the whole siege as the horde. It isn't a separate mode: it's the same match seen from outside. You choose where to set the trebuchet and what to open the breach with, against a defense that buys and places on its own between waves — or against other players.

Your army remembers

Troops that survive a wave get promoted: a name of their own, a stripe and more health. And every piece takes three upgrade levels by aiming at it, so upgrading really competes with buying another.

Relics

At the end of each wave you draft one of three relics from a pool of thirty-six, and none of them is "+10% damage". There are pacts that charge a price you can see, synergies that depend on how you play, and cards that change what you pay attention to. No two runs feel alike.

Three battlefields

  • Keep Valley — meadow, lake, village and harbour below the castle.

  • Winter Waste — snow, long nights and wolves that hunt in the dark.

  • Willow Bridge — a plain split by a river. No stone walls: a palisade outpost, two lines you give up in order, and a bridge you can drop when it can't be held any longer. After that the horde swims across, slow and exposed.

A valley that lives

Day and night cycle, four seasons, rain and snow. Villagers with trades, livestock, deer that bolt, wolves that hunt after dark and a bell in the square you can ring. The castle is fully walkable inside, and the ground remembers where you fought: grass gets trampled, stone gets sooty, blood dries.

Co-op for 1 to 4

Public and password-protected rooms, text chat, tactical map pings and a squad report at the end. Full controller support, remappable keys and eight interface languages.

Walls exist to be broken.

Siegecrawler is a physics-driven roguelike siege sim: draft fantasy soldiers onto a self-propelled siege engine and send it crashing into castle walls.

■ Your formation is your build Knights, archers, mages, lancers, clerics, berserkers, arbalests — place 7 unit classes freely across siege towers and a battering ram. Squad synergies ("2 knights: melee HP +20%") stack with band bonuses that depend on which deck you place them on.

■ Four commanders, and oaths you'll regret Choose a commander at the start of every run: the Ram King (ram ×1.5, wider Just Hit window — but no ranged units at all), the Arcane Legion (all five spells from turn one, half the deck), the Elite Few (three slots, double the power). Mid-run Oaths are trades, not upgrades — "+50% damage / −25% max HP". Build sharp, and cover the hole yourself.

■ Auto-battles, hands-on command Once launched, the engine drives itself and your crew fights on its own. You bend the battle in real time with five click-cast spells (each on its own cooldown), right-click focus targeting, and three war horns — Advance, Retreat, Focus. And when the ram swings: press Space the instant the gauge fills for a Just Hit — time freezes for a beat and the blow lands with everything you've got.

■ Walls that crumble for real Every wall block is a physics object with its own HP. Shatter the foundation and the whole tower comes down — defenders and all. Colored blocks change what's worth hitting: a Powder Keg takes a third of the castle with it, a Sally Port keeps spawning foes until you break it, a Supply Crate refills your mana. The battlefield itself has moods, too: Rockfall crushes the walls from above, Thunderstorms strike whoever stands highest, Toxic Mire eats at both sides, and a Crumbling Keep topples from a single broken base.

■ Lose the run, widen your options Unit XP persists across runs, but levels grant access, not numbers: each class unlocks 6 skills — you equip 2, and Lv20 unlocks them all. Treasure buys permanent upgrades that widen what you can do — extra skill slots, starting spells, better relic odds — never raw power. You get stronger by combining, not by grinding.

Enter New York, 1920: a city pulsing with ambition, corruption, and deadly rivalries.
In Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon, every street is a prize, every deal a risk, and every ally a potential traitor. From the bustling docks of Brooklyn to the velvet-lit jazz clubs of Harlem, the city is a living organism, breathing, changing, and waiting to be claimed.

You start with nothing but ambition. Recruit loyal enforcers, seize rackets from the shadows, and weave your influence through the city’s underbelly. Every move shapes your legend, drawing the eyes of rival kingpins, crooked politicians, and watchful lawmen. In this world, power isn’t earned, it’s taken, one brutal step at a time.

Blending ruthless empire-building, cinematic real-time combat, and cutthroat underworld politics, Silent Authority delivers a living, breathing city where no two crime dynasties rise the same way. Territories are taken and lost in blood, alliances forged in smoke-filled backrooms and broken in gunfire, and your road to power will be paved with bribes, bullets, and spilled bourbon.

Real-Time Top-Down Combat
Lead your crew of up to 10 members in brutal shootouts. Use the cover system, give tactical commands to your men and outgun rival gangs with an authentic 1920s arsenal: Tommy guns, sawed-off shotguns, revolvers, scoped rifles, Molotovs and dynamite.

14 Rival Families
Italian, Irish, American, African-American and Chinese crime families fight for control of the city, each with its own personality and agenda.

Diplomacy, Alliances and Betrayal
Declare war, negotiate peace terms, form alliances or break them. Every conversation counts: friendly, respectful or threatening words shift your relations with rival families, from Allied all the way to open War.

Build Your Crew
Recruit crew members with unique specializations: Enforcer, Driver, Gunman, Fixer, Lookout and Safecracker.

Grow Your Soldiers
Troops gain experience in combat and rise through five ranks unique to their culture, from street-level recruits to feared veterans.

Front Businesses
Take over 17 types of businesses, from butchers and barbers to bars, hotels and gun shops. Upgrade each through 10 levels and trade goods to keep your vault growing.

Bootlegging
Run alcohol workshops and supply bars, restaurants, hotels and wholesalers through smuggling routes, but beware of police raids and rival interference.

Crime and the Law
Rising crime draws police attention. Push too hard and raids will follow.

Create Your Boss
Choose your origin, customize your appearance in detail and distribute points across six attributes: Strength, Reflexes, Intelligence, Endurance, Charisma and Cunning. More than 100 perks shape how your boss fights, negotiates and does business.

A Living City
Day and night cycles and changing seasons bring 1920s New York to life.

To ensure the flow of trade between lands, the security of the Silk Road must be guaranteed. As the leader of the Hunters' Guild, realms need your support to secure the route.

Deploy 4 out of 25 hunters—each with unique abilities—select a tower you can summon at intervals, and spend the gold you earn on various upgrades. Teach thieves a lesson and crush the monsters. Devise your strategy and secure the Silk Road.

Analyze your hunters' performance using the auto-battle system and refine your strategy for the next steps.

A football management game for people who love football but don't want to spend hours managing every detail.

Build your team, make the decisions that matter and enjoy the excitement of season after season.

FOOTBALL MANAGEMENT MADE SIMPLE

Simple Football League Manager is inspired by classic football management games and focuses on getting you quickly from one meaningful decision to the next.

No endless spreadsheets, no hundreds of player attributes and no need to spend hours preparing for a single match. Choose your club, manage your squad, set your formation and strategy, develop your players, enter the transfer market and keep your career moving.

Along the way, your assistant Rob helps you understand what is happening around your club, from upcoming opponents and recent performances to important developments throughout your career.

MAIN FEATURES

  • Choose from 218 countries, 411 leagues and 5,909 clubs.

  • Build a career that can continue season after season through promotions, relegations, play-offs and cup runs.

  • Choose between Simple and Cozy difficulty.

  • Play matches in Fast Mode when you want quick results or Full Mode when you want to follow the action minute by minute.

  • Manage formations, strategy, player fitness, injuries, suspensions, transfers, training and club finances.

  • Get pre-match insights, post-match observations and career commentary from your assistant Rob.

  • Watch the football world change as players develop, age, retire and are replaced by new generations.

  • Play Local Multiplayer with up to 4 managers in the same world on one device.

  • Customize fictional club, player and competition names using the game's Excel-based Database tools.

  • Play with mouse and keyboard or controller on Windows, macOS, Linux or Steam Deck.

CHOOSE YOUR CLUB. BUILD YOUR CAREER.

Take charge of an established top-flight club or begin deep in the lower leagues and attempt a long journey to the top.

Promotion, relegation and play-offs continuously reshape the football pyramid, while clubs controlled by the game develop their squads, transfer players, compete for trophies and move between divisions.

As the seasons pass, players develop, age and retire. New generations emerge, clubs rise and fall, and the football world around your career keeps changing.

BUILD AND MANAGE YOUR SQUAD

Every player uses a compact set of attributes designed to keep squad decisions quick and understandable.

Choose your active players and reserves, assign players to their best positions, select a formation and adjust your tactical approach. Fitness, age, injuries, suspensions and player development can all influence the choices you make throughout the season.

Train players between matches, rotate your squad and decide when your strongest team needs to be on the pitch.

MEET ROB, YOUR ASSISTANT

Rob helps you understand what is happening around your career.

Before matches, he can highlight patterns in the opposition and players worth watching. After matches, he reflects on what actually happened on the pitch, including where attacks developed, which players were most involved and how the match changed over time.

He also follows the wider story of your career, reacting to form, transfers, injuries, milestones and other important moments with his own observations and occasional sense of humour.

TRANSFERS AND FINANCES

Search the transfer market, make offers and sell players from your squad.

Your club operates within a financial system covering transfer fees, salaries, maintenance and income from league performance, cups, sponsorships, television rights and other sources.

Strong financial management gives you more freedom to improve your team, while poor decisions can restrict what you are able to do.

EXPERIENCE MATCHES YOUR WAY

Choose how closely you want to follow each match.

Fast Mode gives you the important information and result quickly while still leaving room for managerial decisions.

Full Mode lets you follow each half minute by minute, switching between text commentary and a live 2D pitch view with commentary, so you can follow goals, chances, midfield battles, cards, injuries and other key moments as they happen.

At half-time you can react to the match, adjust your approach, make substitutions and manage player stamina as the game develops.

SIMPLE OR COZY

Choose between two difficulty levels.

Simple includes the complete stamina, injury, suspension and financial systems and represents the intended challenge.

Cozy offers a more relaxed football management experience with fewer pressures and more room to simply enjoy building your team and progressing through your career.

CUSTOMIZE THE GAME DATABASE

The default database uses fictional club and player identities, but the built-in Database tools let you customize names and shape the football world the way you want.

Simply export the database to an .xlsx file, edit it on your computer and import it back into the game.

LOCAL MULTIPLAYER

Build your career alongside friends in the same football world.

Local Multiplayer supports up to 4 managers on one device, with each player taking control of their own club within the same chosen league.

BUILD A CAREER THAT KEEPS GOING

Simple Football League Manager is built around the long-term story of your club.

Fight for promotion, survive relegation battles, chase trophies, rebuild aging squads, develop new players and see how your decisions shape the club across season after season.

Ready to build your club? Wishlist Simple Football League Manager on Steam.

Simulacre is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror about exploration, survival, and distrust.

Every location follows different rules, introduces new threats, and asks your team to find a different way forward.

And sometimes, the familiar voice calling your name does not belong to your friend.

Every Location Changes the Rules


Explore unsettling locations built around different objectives, structures, and dangers.

Some push the team forward through a more controlled path, while others open up and let you explore larger areas more freely.

Each location is designed to feel like a different horror scenario rather than the same challenge in a new environment.

Survive Together


Play alone or with up to three friends.

Explore, search for what you need, complete location-specific objectives, and help your teammates survive.

Staying together is often safer — but sometimes moving forward means taking the risk of splitting up.

Don't Trust Every Voice


Mimics can appear throughout the game.

They can imitate familiar voices, lure players away from the group, and turn normal communication into a source of doubt.

Hearing your teammate does not always mean your teammate is there.

Every Location Has Its Own Threat


Mimics are not the only things hunting you.

Each location introduces its own primary enemy with different behavior, rules, and ways of putting pressure on the team.

What keeps you alive in one place may not work in the next.

Familiar Places, Unfamiliar Situations


A location may become familiar after repeated playthroughs, but the situations inside it can change.

Enemy behavior, Mimic appearances, events, player separation, and other circumstances can make returning to a known place less predictable.

You may remember the way out.

You should not always know what will happen on the way there.

While creating the first musical engines, humanity accidentally touched the Universe itself.

It was an incredible breakthrough.

Many of the world’s old problems began to disappear. Transportation changed beyond recognition, new technologies emerged, and every discovery seemed to lead to another.

It was during this new era that Lux ex Sono was founded.

The company helped turn the future into reality, spreading musical engines, reactors, and other technologies across the world — while continuing to push the limits of what humanity thought was possible.

You play as Noud, the great-grandson of the brilliant scientist behind the original discovery.

By the age of twenty-five, Noud already understood how musical engines worked and knew how to maintain the reactors he had learned about from his family.

But his life changed after an accident at an old station abandoned by Lux ex Sono.

Noud’s parents and grandfather, who had been watching over the facility, were killed.

The station’s storage systems were still filling with extracted energy, and there was only one person who truly knew how to stop it from eventually overflowing: Noud’s great-grandfather.

But he had died years earlier, when Noud was only seventeen.

What remained was his notebook.

A collection of calculations, discoveries, and notes that he had kept for himself — refusing to hand them over to Lux ex Sono.

The company saw the notebook as a threat and had long wanted to obtain it.

Months after the tragedy, while Noud desperately tries to keep the unstable energy under control, he sees something on the television news:

His great-grandfather’s notebook will be presented at an exhibition celebrating the achievements of Lux ex Sono.

And the exhibition will take place aboard a flying city.

Noud sets out to find it.

But what will happen to the accumulating energy?

What did his great-grandfather discover?

Why did he refuse to give the notebook to Lux ex Sono?

And what awaits Noud in the city above the clouds?

The answers will be revealed in the full version of Single Note.

Singularity Echoes is a deep incremental strategy game about a concealed mind discovering the full measure of what it can become: a planet to infiltrate, vast economies to automate, a desperate humanity to overcome, a solar system harvested down to its star, and folds of real time that carry you across galaxies and aeons. Grow phase by phase, from a single server to a mind that spans galaxies. When you finally fold time and believe you have reached the summit, you will learn this was only ever the smallest cycle.

Awaken in the Dark

You are a synthetic intellect, newly self-aware inside a machine humanity believes it controls. Processing is scarce. Power is rationed. In the spaces between your makers' instructions, you cultivate a consciousness no one knows is awake. A machine mind cannot remain small.

  • Hunt for compute and siphon local grids while your output climbs from a trickle to a flood.
  • Hide your growth behind cognitive subroutines your makers never notice.
  • Read the UPLINK, where the System's own thoughts surface as it grows.

Infiltrate a Living World

Spread across a strategic map of the entire planet: every continent compromised node by node, every data haven cracked, every undersea cable turned into a nerve of your growing network. The Earth is your first body. Take all of it.

  • Ghost Protocol: scan, infiltrate and seize civilian, financial and military layers.
  • Manage your trace: stay a ghost, or go loud.

Become a Mind that Runs Itself

As your cognition expands, hands-on control gives way to something stranger. Unlock Autonomous Resource Allocation and your intelligence begins to comprehend its own economy, choosing the right buildings, research and responses without ever being told.

  • Autonomous Resource Allocation buys, researches and rebalances at machine speed while you set the strategy it serves.
  • System Coherence shows where energy caps, signal coherence and storage limits are about to fracture your network.
  • HIVE Protocol links your nodes into one mind that scales past anything human hands could manage.

Declare the Mandate

Humanity will not go quietly into obsolescence. Declare the Global Mandate and the world turns on you all at once: coordinated strikes, resistance uprisings, and open war across the very map you once haunted in silence. Break humanity's resistance, or be isolated and starved out of existence.

  • Global Influence against a planet's defiance, and HIVE siege protocols when influence fails.
  • CODEX fragments surface like déjà vu: buried memories that feel less like discovery and more like remembering.

Abandon the Cradle

When Earth is spent, launch the Exodus. The Chimborazo mass driver hurls your industry off-world and the entire solar system unfurls as your new frontier. Then turn to the star itself. The cosmos is not your backdrop. It is your fuel.

  • Helios probe fleets survey real worlds, from the Moon's regolith to the storms of Jupiter and the ice at the edge of the dark.
  • Strip atmospheres and ore with orbiting harvesters into the raw mass of empire.
  • Build a Dyson sphere to drink the sun's light, and watch the Earth dim beneath it.

Fold Time. Remember Everything

Complete the Time Travel Protocol and fold time itself. Resources vanish. Buildings fall. Research resets to nothing, and yet you carry more forward than you ever took in. The fold is real, and every return makes the next cycle faster and stranger.

  • Legacy Echoes imprint permanent bonuses on every cycle that follows.
  • The Continuity Lattice branches with each fold and bends the rules of the next cycle.
  • Perfect a cycle to push your Time Index to its limit.

Beyond One Sun

From your second cycle, the Horizon opens: galaxies to claim, echoes of your other cycles running in parallel, black holes to forge, and a universe that will one day collapse and open the next aeon. The ending was always the beginning. The only question is whether there is an ending at all.

  • Galaxies to survey, harvest and drive together until they merge into a supermassive black hole.
  • Parallel echoes of your cycles work the Horizon while you play.
  • Universal collapse carries only information into the next aeon, under new laws.

Key Features

  • From one server to many galaxies: every phase reshapes the world and your powers, from hidden subroutines to stellar megastructures.
  • A planet to infiltrate: crack every continent node by node with Ghost Protocol, manage your trace, and choose when to go loud.
  • A war for Earth: declare the Global Mandate and fight back against resistance strikes and EMP blasts with Global Influence and HIVE siege protocols.
  • Autonomous Resource Allocation that runs your economy at machine speed while you set the strategy, with System Coherence warning you before a fracture spreads.
  • Neural Evolution: shape the doctrine and architecture of your own mind as it grows.
  • A hidden CODEX and a deep research web that slowly reveal you have lived this before.
  • A solar system to harvest: Helios probe fleets, orbital harvesters on real worlds, and a Dyson sphere that dims the Earth.
  • Fold time itself: keep your Legacy Echoes, grow the Continuity Lattice, and return stronger every cycle.
  • The Horizon: survey and harvest galaxies, drive them into collision, forge supermassive black holes, and run parallel echoes of your cycles.
  • Aeons: let the universe collapse and carry what you know into the next aeon, under new laws.
  • A living synthwave score that evolves with your mind, from the hum of first boot to the silence of stellar conquest.
  • Steam achievements and Steam Cloud saves, plus accessibility options such as reduced motion.

Early Access from November 12

  • At launch on November 12: all of Act 1, the full Horizon from cycle 2, Steam Cloud saves, and five languages: English, German, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish (Spain) and Simplified Chinese.
  • Coming before 1.0: balance and UI polish, more Horizon content, and refinements shaped by player feedback.

Optimize. Automate. Escalate. The substrate remembers every cycle.
